Load neuronal + non-neuronal assignments
```{r setup}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(khroma)

animal_metadata = readr::read_csv("../shared objs and code/mouse_meta.csv")
animal_metadata$ID = as.character(animal_metadata$ID)

#remove animal 1537 for the paired analysis - lower yield and was replaced by 18261 (reason why we have 3 of B6xBXD19_Female_5XFAD for strain_sex_genotype)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% filter(ID != "1537")

animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% dplyr::select("ID", "Sex", "Line.short", "Genotype", "Age (months)") %>% dplyr::rename("age" = "Age (months)","strain" = "Line.short", "sex" = "Sex", "genotype" = "Genotype", "animal_id" = "ID")
#load animal phenotype data
animal_phenotype_data = read.csv("./calo_bx_data_clean_20260501.csv")

#filter to just < 14 and chow diet
animal_phenotype_data = animal_phenotype_data %>% filter(AgeGrp <= 14) %>% filter(Diet == "Chow")

animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice = animal_phenotype_data 

cur_strains = animal_metadata$strain %>% unique

#add age of death, then filter behavioral metadata for this timepoint, since some mice were phenotyped more than just prior to death. But our analysis will focus on the data collected from the timepoint prior to death. 
animal_phenotype_weight = animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice %>% filter(!is.na(Weight)) %>% select(ID, AgeGrp, Sex, Genotype, Line.short, Weight) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = AgeGrp, values_from = Weight)
library(tidyverse)
library(khroma)



animal_phenotype_weight = animal_phenotype_weight %>% filter(Line.short %in% cur_strains)
# Reshape weight data back to long format for plotting
weight_long <- animal_phenotype_weight %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(ID, Sex, Genotype, Line.short),
    names_to = "AgeGrp",
    values_to = "Weight"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Weight)) %>%
  mutate(
    AgeGrp_num = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", AgeGrp)),
    strain_sex = paste(Line.short, Sex, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  arrange(AgeGrp_num) %>%
  mutate(AgeGrp = factor(AgeGrp, levels = unique(AgeGrp[order(AgeGrp_num)])))


library(tidyverse)
library(khroma)

# Continuous x: AgeGrp_num already exists in weight_long from your reshape
weight_long$Sex = factor(weight_long$Sex, levels = c("Male","Female"))
weight_long$Genotype = factor(weight_long$Genotype, levels = c("Ntg","5XFAD"))

# Per-(age × sex × genotype) sample sizes for annotation
library(ggrepel)


weight_means = weight_long %>%
  group_by(AgeGrp_num, Sex, Genotype) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_weight = mean(Weight),
    n = n(),
    sem_weight = sd(Weight) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


weight_n_show <- weight_means %>%
  filter(AgeGrp_num %in% c(3, 6,10, 14)) %>%
  mutate(lab_y = mean_weight + ifelse(Genotype == "Ntg", 8, -8))

weight_mean_overlay = ggplot(weight_long, aes(x = AgeGrp_num, y = Weight, color = Genotype)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = ID), alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.15) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = Genotype), fun = mean,
               geom = "line", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = weight_means, aes(x = AgeGrp_num, y = mean_weight), size = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(data = weight_means,
                aes(x = AgeGrp_num, y = mean_weight, ymin = mean_weight - sem_weight, ymax = mean_weight + sem_weight),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.4) +
geom_label(data = weight_n_show,
             aes(y = lab_y, label = paste0("n = ", n)),
             size = 5, fill = "#E6E6E6", label.size = 0,
           nudge_x = .2,
             label.padding = unit(.08, "lines"),
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Sex) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(weight_long$AgeGrp_num)),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.12))) +
  scale_color_bright() +
  labs(x = "Age (months)", y = "Weight (g)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(2, "pt"),
        text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none")


# ============================================================
# CFA + Sensorimotor_composite at snRNA-seq endpoints (6 and 14 mo)
# Boxplot per genotype, faceted by sex x timepoint, same strain restriction
# ============================================================



cfa_sleep_long = animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice %>%
  filter(Line.short %in% cur_strains) %>%
  mutate(AgeGrp_num = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", AgeGrp))) %>%
  filter(AgeGrp_num %in% c(6, 14)) %>%
  select(ID, Sex, Genotype, strain = Line.short, AgeGrp_num,
         CFA = CFC.PS4, sleep_24hrtotal) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(CFA, sleep_24hrtotal), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(
    metric    = factor(metric, levels = c("CFA", "sleep_24hrtotal")),
    Sex       = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    Genotype  = factor(Genotype, levels = c("Ntg", "5XFAD")),
    timepoint = factor(paste0(AgeGrp_num, " mo"), levels = c("6 mo", "14 mo"))
  )
cfa_sleep_long = cfa_sleep_long %>% 
  mutate(
    value = case_when(
      metric == "sleep_24hrtotal" ~ value / 3600,
      .default = value
    ),
    metric = case_when(
      metric == "sleep_24hrtotal" ~ "hrs_sleep",
      .default = metric
    )
  )

cond_lev <- c("Male, 6 mo", "Male, 14 mo", "Female, 6 mo", "Female, 14 mo")
cfa_sleep_long <- cfa_sleep_long %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(paste0(Sex, ", ", timepoint), levels = cond_lev))
cfa_sm_n <- cfa_sleep_long %>% count(metric, condition, Genotype, name = "n")
```

```{r}
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(ggsignif)

# ---- cluster-robust tests ----
sig_results <- data.frame()

for (cur_age in c(6, 14)) {
  for (cur_sex in c("Male", "Female")) {
    for (cur_metric in c("CFA", "hrs_sleep")) {

      df <- cfa_sleep_long %>%
        filter(AgeGrp_num == cur_age, Sex == cur_sex, metric == cur_metric) %>%
        filter(!is.na(value))

      mod_lm <- lm(value ~ Genotype, data = df)
      ct <- lmtest::coeftest(mod_lm,
                             vcov = sandwich::vcovCL(mod_lm, cluster = ~strain, type = "HC2"))
      pval <- ct["Genotype5XFAD", "Pr(>|t|)"]

      sig_results <- rbind(sig_results, data.frame(
        metric    = cur_metric,
        condition = paste0(cur_sex, ", ", cur_age, " mo"),
        p_value   = pval,
        y_max     = max(df$value, na.rm = TRUE)
      ))
    }
  }
}

sig_results <- sig_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    condition  = factor(condition, levels = cond_lev),
    metric     = factor(metric, levels = c("CFA", "hrs_sleep")),
    stars      = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    ),
    xmin        = "Ntg",
    xmax        = "5XFAD",
    y_position  = y_max * 1.08,
    annotations = stars
  )

# ---- plot ----
cfa_sleep_plot <- ggplot(cfa_sleep_long,
                         aes(x = Genotype, y = value, fill = Genotype)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.5, color = "grey25") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.18, height = 0, size = 0.7, alpha = 0.4, color = "grey25") +
  geom_text(data = cfa_sm_n,
            aes(x = Genotype, y = Inf, label = paste0("n=", n)),
            vjust = 1.4, size = 5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_signif(data = sig_results,
              aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
                  y_position = y_position, annotations = annotations),
              manual = TRUE, textsize = 5, tip_length = 0.02,
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ condition, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(metric = c(CFA = "% Freezing (CFA Assay)", hrs_sleep = "Hours Slept"))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.22))) +
  scale_fill_bright() +
  labs(x = "Genotype", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
        text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(2, "pt"),
        legend.position = "none")

cfa_sleep_plot

```


```{r}
combined_plot = weight_mean_overlay + cfa_sleep_plot   &
  theme(plot.margin       = margin(1, 1, 1, 1),
        axis.title.y      = element_text(margin = margin(r = 1)),
        axis.text.y       = element_text(margin = margin(r = 1)),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(1, "pt"))

ggsave("weight_cfa_llnge_representation.pdf", combined_plot,
       width = 15, height = 7)
```
